nodes.name: Daily 10:00 Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs daily at 10:00 (cron 0 10 * * *), well inside the 9am-9pm calling window the backend enforces. Set the instance/workflow timezone so 10:00 = IST. Change the cron for a different time.

nodes.name: Get Due Compliance List
nodes.notes: PLACEHOLDER data source. Set env var TCC_DUE_LIST_URL to an endpoint returning a JSON array like [{ 'name': 'Acme Traders', 'phone': '+919812345678', 'return_type': 'GSTR-3B', 'due_date': '2026-08-11' }] for clients whose compliance deadline is in the next few days. REPLACE with an n8n Zoho CRM node running a COQL query, or a Google Sheets 'Get Rows' node, or keep HTTP if your backend exposes a due-list endpoint. n8n emits one item per array element; if your source wraps the list (e.g. { data: [...] }) extract the array before the loop.

nodes.name: Loop Over Clients
nodes.notes: Batch size 1 -> process one client at a time. Output 2 (loop) builds the payload and calls the backend, then wires back here; output 1 (done) ends at the NoOp once the list is exhausted.

nodes.name: Build Reminder Payload
nodes.notes: Thin mapping only. Maps each client row to the outbound payload fields: agent=gst_reminder, to_number=phone, and the variables client_name/return_type/due_date. Use agent=payment_reminder instead for overdue-payment campaigns.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ client_id: 'tcc', agent: $json.agent, to_number: $json.to_number, variables: { client_name: $json.client_name, return_type: $json.return_type, due_date: $json.due_date }, check_dnd: true }) }}

nodes.name: Call Backend - Outbound Reminder
nodes.notes: Calls the backend middleware, which enforces the 9am-9pm window, suppression/DND and consent - n8n only triggers. Base URL http://tcc-voice-backend:3000 is a docker-compose placeholder; change it here or set env TCC_BACKEND_URL and use ={{ $env.TCC_BACKEND_URL }}/calls/outbound.

nodes.name: All Reminders Queued
nodes.notes: End of run. All due clients have been queued with the backend.
